hook.en: When a bank needs a branch manager, it may promote its own officer or advertise in the newspaper. Each choice has its own merits.
hook.kn: ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿಗೆ ಶಾಖಾ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕ ಬೇಕಾದಾಗ ತನ್ನ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಗೆ ಬಡ್ತಿ ನೀಡಬಹುದು ಅಥವಾ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜಾಹೀರಾತು ನೀಡಬಹುದು. ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಅನುಕೂಲಗಳಿವೆ.

narration.en: When a bank needs a branch manager, it may promote its own officer or advertise in the newspaper. Each choice has its own merits.
narration.kn: ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿಗೆ ಶಾಖಾ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥಾಪಕ ಬೇಕಾದಾಗ ತನ್ನ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಗೆ ಬಡ್ತಿ ನೀಡಬಹುದು ಅಥವಾ ಪತ್ರಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜಾಹೀರಾತು ನೀಡಬಹುದು. ಎರಡಕ್ಕೂ ತಮ್ಮದೇ ಅನುಕೂಲಗಳಿವೆ.

body.en: Recruitment is the process of searching for prospective employees and stimulating them to apply. Internal sources are transfers and promotions. They motivate employees, simplify selection, are cheaper and need less training, but they shut out fresh talent, may cause lethargy and cannot fill all posts in a new firm.

They motivate employees, simplify selection, are cheaper and need less training, but they shut out fresh talent, may cause lethargy and cannot fill all posts in a new firm.
narration.kn: ನೇಮಕಾತಿ ಎಂದರೆ ಸಂಭಾವ್ಯ ಉದ್ಯೋಗಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಿ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಲು ಪ್ರೇರೇಪಿಸುವುದು. ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬಡ್ತಿ ಆಂತರಿಕ ಮೂಲಗಳು.

title.en: On the board: sources of recruitment

narration.en: Watch the board as we build this up step by step.

say.en: Recruitment has two families of sources.
External: direct recruitment, casual callers, advertisement, employment exchange.
Also placement agencies, campus recruitment, employee referrals, labour contractors and web publishing.
Internal motivates staff; external brings fresh talent.

body.en: External sources include direct recruitment, casual callers, advertisement, employment exchanges, placement agencies and management consultants, campus recruitment, recommendations of employees, labour contractors and web publishing. They bring qualified and fresh talent, wider choice and competitive spirit, but are costly and lengthy, and may upset existing staff.

points.en: Merits: qualified personnel, wider choice, fresh talent, competitive spirit
Limits: dissatisfaction among existing staff, lengthy, costly

narration.kn: ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಮೂಲಗಳು ಹೊಸ ಪ್ರತಿಭೆ ಮತ್ತು ವಿಶಾಲ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ, ಆದರೆ ದುಬಾರಿ ಮತ್ತು ದೀರ್ಘ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ; ಹಾಲಿ ನೌಕರರಲ್ಲಿ ಅಸಮಾಧಾನ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡಬಹುದು.

problem.en: Suggest a suitable source in each case: (a) 200 daily-wage workers for a highway project; (b) 15 engineering trainees for an IT firm; (c) a senior post where a capable deputy already works; (d) a rare data-science expert.

steps.en: (a) Large number of unskilled workers quickly: labour contractors.
(c) Capable deputy available: internal source, promotion.
(d) Rare specialist: placement agencies and management consultants, or web publishing.

answer.en: Labour contractors, campus recruitment, promotion, and placement agencies/consultants respectively.

narration.en: Let us work through this case together. Suggest a suitable source in each case: (a) 200 daily-wage workers for a highway project; (b) 15 engineering trainees for an IT firm; (c) a senior post where a capable deputy already works; (d) a rare data-science expert.
Team quiz. Each row is a team; discuss quietly and give one answer per team.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಸಾಲು ಒಂದು ತಂಡ; ಮೆಲ್ಲನೆ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ತಂಡಕ್ಕೆ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಿ.

narration.en: Now some CBSE board pattern questions: assertion–reason and case based.

points.en: Recruitment searches for candidates and makes them apply.
points.kn: ನೇಮಕಾತಿ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಿ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: External sources bring fresh talent but cost more.
points.kn: ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಮೂಲಗಳು ಹೊಸ ಪ್ರತಿಭೆ ತರುತ್ತವೆ, ಆದರೆ ದುಬಾರಿ.

homework.en: Explain any five external sources of recruitment.

narration.en: Recap. Recruitment searches for candidates and makes them apply. Internal sources: transfer and promotion. External sources bring fresh talent but cost more.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ನೇಮಕಾತಿ ಅಭ್ಯರ್ಥಿಗಳನ್ನು ಹುಡುಕಿ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಆಂತರಿಕ ಮೂಲಗಳು: ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಬಡ್ತಿ. ಬಾಹ್ಯ ಮೂಲಗಳು ಹೊಸ ಪ್ರತಿಭೆ ತರುತ್ತವೆ, ಆದರೆ ದುಬಾರಿ.
